# pbs_metrics_server (Resource)

Manages a PBS metrics server configuration.

Supports InfluxDB (both UDP and HTTP protocols) for metrics export. Use this resource to configure where
PBS should send its performance and usage metrics.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The unique name identifier for the metrics server. This is used to identify the metrics server configuration.
- `type` (String) The type of metrics server. Valid values: `influxdb-udp`, `influxdb-http`.

### Optional

- `bucket` (String) InfluxDB bucket name where metrics will be stored. Required for `influxdb-http` type.
- `comment` (String) A comment describing this metrics server configuration.
- `enable` (Boolean) Enable or disable metrics export to this server. Defaults to `true`.
- `max_body_size` (Number) Maximum body size for HTTP requests in bytes. Only applicable for `influxdb-http` type. Defaults to `25000000` (25MB).
- `mtu` (Number) Maximum transmission unit for the metrics connection. Defaults to `1500`.
- `organization` (String) InfluxDB organization name. Required for `influxdb-http` type.
- `port` (Number) The server port. Typical ports: `8089` (InfluxDB UDP), `8086` (InfluxDB HTTP). Can be used instead of `url` for backwards compatibility.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol for InfluxDB UDP connection. Valid values: `udp`, `tcp`. Only applicable for `influxdb-udp` type.
- `server` (String) The server address (hostname or IP) of the metrics server. Can be used instead of `url` for backwards compatibility.
- `timeout` (Number) HTTP request timeout in seconds. Only applicable for `influxdb-http` type. Defaults to `5`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) InfluxDB API token for authentication. Required for `influxdb-http` type.
- `url` (String) Full URL for InfluxDB HTTP, including protocol (e.g., `http://influxdb:8086` or `https://influxdb:443`). If specified, this takes precedence over separate `server` and `port` fields. Only applicable for `influxdb-http` type.
- `verify_tls` (Boolean) Whether to verify TLS certificate for HTTPS connections. Only applicable for `influxdb-http` type. Defaults to `true`.
